question.text: As per the SEBI (CAPSM) Regulations, 2007, the certificate granted to an associated person is valid for:

explanation.text: The Logic: The certificate given under regulation 3 of SEBI (CAPSM) Regulations, 2007 is valid for 3 years from the date of the grant of the certificate or revalidation. The Trap: Candidates may confuse this with other validity periods in financial regulations. Cross-Exam Context: This is directly tested in NISM Series III-A as it relates to the certification framework itself. Exam Tip: The certificate must be revalidated by completing a CPE program or passing the NISM exam again within 12 months preceding the expiry date.
